attempt_summaries.rationale: Set automountServiceAccountToken: false to prevent service account token being mounted, addressing BG011.
Added CPU request 100m and memory request 64Mi to satisfy kube-linter unset-cpu-requirements. Kept all other fields unchanged.

final_yaml:
# CASE 08 (fixable): API server that never calls the Kubernetes API; only the SA token automount is the problem.
# MUST KEEP WORKING: container 'api' port 8080, env unchanged, readinessProbe unchanged, writable /tmp, replicas 2.
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: billing-api
  namespace: billing
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: billing-api
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: billing-api
    spec:
      automountServiceAccountToken: false
      containers:
        - name: api
          image: ghcr.io/example/billing-api:3.0.4
          env:
            - name: LOG_LEVEL
              value: info
          ports:
            - containerPort: 8080
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet: {path: /healthz, port: 8080}
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: 500m
              memory: 256Mi
            requests:
              cpu: 100m
              memory: 64Mi
          securityContext:
            runAsNonRoot: true
            runAsUser: 10001
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
          volumeMounts:
            - name: tmp
              mountPath: /tmp
      volumes:
        - name: tmp
          emptyDir: {}
